pages.title: Overview
pages.text:
A Forest-themed defensive tool that works like a vanilla shield: right-click to block, negates all damage while consuming durability.

• Durability: 672 (twice the vanilla shield). Enchantable: Unbreaking, Mending, Thorns, etc. (enchantability same as vanilla)
• Blocking reflects 2 thorns damage to attackers within 3 blocks (ignores armor)
• Player use: the damaged enemy gets infinite Poison

pages.title: Doll Use
pages.text: When a doll holds the shield in its offhand, it reflects 100% of incoming damage.

pages.title: Crafting Recipe
pages.text: Oak logs surround a central iron block.
